posts.text: Marco Rubio after @ABC calls him up to guest host @TheView as damage control after today’s insufferable propaganda ☺️
Also applicable for “ways to piss off Satan.”

Ways to piss off the women of @TheView:

1. Get married. 

2. Have kids. 

3. Tell other people they should experience the joy of getting married and having kids.

That’s it. That’s the tweet.

"Get married and have a ton of kids!!

Get married when you're too young and have more kids than you can afford. Take a job you're not qualified for. Live boldly."

Again, I stand by it, @TheView.

Video

I stand by it.

There really is a Charlie Kirk tweet for everything.


Charlie Kirk (@charliekirk11)

More people should get married young and have more kids than they can afford.



— https://nitter.net/charliekirk11/status/1947489521056288935#m

I don't know what woman needs to hear this today, but if a feminist is screaming at you that you are incapable of having a baby *and* a thriving career, you shouldn't listen.

It's a shallow, pathetic way to tell women we aren't strong enough to do both.

You can.

"NEVER HAVE CHILDREN, YOUNG WOMEN!!"

Yell and scream @TheView hosts, most of whom have their own children & make millions of dollars, proving you can indeed "have it all."


TheBlaze (@theblaze)

The View’s Sunny Hostin: “I think it’s really reckless to be suggesting that people should have children in this country.”

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/theblaze/status/2038665904431497635#m
Get married. Have kids. Your life will be infinitely better because of it.

And if you just can't help yourself in the meantime & want to grab some popcorn - here's the whole segment of 5 grown women screeching about how I am the "stupidest" person on the Internet, who should divorce my husband, and probably never should have become a mom in the first place.

Misery sure loves projection, doesn't it?

Video

I find no coincidence that this week is Holy Week, and the family represents perhaps the biggest and strongest threat to evil in postmodern culture than anything else.

Again, I reiterate: HAVE THE COURAGE to get married and have a beautiful family. Your life will be better because of it.

This entire show from @TheView is PROPAGANDA--make no mistake about it--and it deserves a response.
